name: Power Pro Kun Pocket 10
original_name: パワプロクンポケット10
source:
Two scenarios are included:

1. Koshien Straight Line Edition「甲子園一直線編」is about high school teams competition.
2. Armored Vehicle Battle Digger「装甲車バトルディッガー編」is about ruins exploration with the tank called Battle Digger.

There is also "Success Mode" that allows to train your team.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作收录两个剧本：

1．“甲子园直线篇”，讲述高中棒球队之间的竞争。
2．“装甲车战斗挖掘者篇”，讲述驾驶名为“战斗挖掘者”的坦克探索遗迹。

此外还有可以训练球队的“成功模式”。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndreview[/url]]
